profile.headline: Software Engineer | Ex-CODE2040 Fellow
profile.summary:
Hello! I'm Mariela, and have been working FT since 2021. I joined through the "Evolve Program", a 2 year rotational program where I rotated onto 4 different teams before ending up on a final placement team.

View my personal website at www.marielahdz.com✨

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
I create webpages for graduate students working on receiving their Master's in Public Health. 
My work involves designing the layout of pages, creating course readers for students (with InDesign), and providing faculty with technical related support to create video lectures.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Shipped “Rescale” feature that helps city planners view and analyze demographic data superimposed over their map to make equitable decisions relating to public transit
Learned and developed in Mapbox, React, Redux, Typescript, and Ruby on Rails

positions.title: CODE2040 Fellow
positions.description:
Two-time fellow (Summer 2019 and Summer 2020)

Learning about being a racial equity advocate in the tech industry through workshops, events, and mentorship.

positions.title: Human Centered Design Consultant
positions.description:
Part of UC Berkeley's premiere human centered design consultancy club. Working in a team setting to provide client with their design aspects.

Consultant from September 2018 to December 2019
Project Mentor from January 2020 to May 2020
Advisor from August 2020 to December 2020

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked on the Engage team (an employee engagement platform) doing full stack work with a front end emphasis.

positions.title: Tech Trek Fellow
positions.description:
Part of a +40 cohort of Black and Latinx students from across the U.S. 

Spent a week in the Bay Area visiting tech companies to gain more insight into the tech workforce and gain access to early career exposure, resources, network connections, and skills-building.

Learned about how to be a champion for equity and inclusion by providing companies with robust feedback, taking on the role of observer through pre- and post-visit surveys and giving valuable insights on workplace culture, equity and inclusion efforts, brand awareness in communities of color, and more.

positions.title: New Technologist
positions.description: Part of a 60 group cohort comprised of college students learning about software engineering and program management.

positions.title: Publications Member
positions.description: Member of Publications team for FAST, UC Berkeley's fashion club on campus. Wrote blogs and updated it to website bi-weekly.

positions.title: Data Scholars Researcher
positions.description:
Analyzed 311 calls in order to understand the future of service center calls.

Used data from SF and created a 95% confidence interval of bootstrapped means for number of calls over a 9-year period.

company.name: UC Berkeley Division of Data Sciences

positions.title: Media Committee Member
positions.description:
As part of the Media committee, my goal was to try and get more people in and out of Berkeley's campus to learn about Codeology and it's mission.

Interviewed 2 members of the club to spotlight their achievements and involvements with Codeology.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
The research that I was a part of during Fall 2017 involved understanding if there is a correlation between using virtual reality headsets and amblyopia/strabismus.

I used MATLAB to plot the relation between subjects' hand grip over a period of time. 
I found a program that would locate the distance of 16 results for ~15 subjects.

positions.title: CS Kickstart
positions.description: Part of a week long program for incoming freshman planning or interested in pursuing a CS/EECS degree at UC Berkeley (run by the A.W.E. Club at UC Berkeley).

organizations.name: Berkeley Innovation
organizations.description: Berkeley Innovation (BI) is the home of human-centered design at UC Berkeley. Since 2003, we’ve united makers, thinkers, tinkerers, and doers from a wide range of disciplines behind a shared love for design innovation. Our mission is to connect Berkeley students to collaborative innovation through education, practice, and thought leadership. Each semester, we provide educational opportunities through guest speakers, designathons, and design "bootcamps." Our consultants tackle real world design problems for our clients and industry partners. In addition to consultant work, we host a variety and social and career events to foster a strong design community at Cal.

organizations.name: Codeology
organizations.description: Codeology is an organization on campus that was established to create a community at UC Berkeley where students support other students throughout their recruiting process and help them learn more about the software engineering industry. As people who have gone through the interviewing process themselves, we believe that students experiencing the stress and expectations to do well in both school and interviews would only benefit from having a support system like this.
